material.description: CDC/NIOSH, “Electrical Safety in the Workplace”, “Qualified vs. unqualified persons”, especially “Unqualified persons”. The source states that only qualified persons should do electrical work and that unqualified persons should not work on energized parts. This supports the competency boundary for electrical work. It does not establish a universal prohibition on every form of repair or maintenance, including work on de-energized equipment; the Claim’s phrase about “independent repair” is broader and remains subject to separate editorial review.
